title: Arrival and the locker photo
notes:
Maya arrived and stayed close to me for the first few minutes.
She then joined the morning routine, washed her hands and found her photo on the locker.
By mat time she was settled and looked for me when the song changed.

title: The sun, on his own
notes:
Leo picked up the red paint and the yellow paint and did not wait for me to choose.
The brush slipped. He looked at me, then started the sun again on his own.
He stayed with the page until it was covered.

title: Arabic at home
notes:
Aisha told Mina, "At home we speak Arabic with my grandma."
She drew her family at the table and said she likes the way her name sounds.
She asked me to write her name in Arabic letters beside the drawing.

title: When the tower fell
notes:
When Sam's tower fell he went quiet and his eyes filled up.
Jonah moved in beside him and held out a block without saying much.
Sam took the block and they started the tower once more.

title: Voting for a song
notes:
At mat time the group voted on which song to sing.
Priya put her hand up and said "I choose the rainbow song because we all know it."
Three children who had not spoken also gave a vote.

title: Two ways to cook dumplings
notes:
Mei said her grandma makes dumplings a different way from Omar's family.
Omar said his family fries them, and Mei said "both ways are good."
They looked at a picture book of family meals from different countries.

title: The red bike
notes:
Nora and Eli both wanted the red bike.
Nora said "we can take turns, that's fair" and turned the sand timer.
She made sure Eli got the first turn because he had been waiting.

title: Worm farm and the garden
notes:
After lunch the group picked up sticks and paper from the yard.
Hana put the food scraps into the worm farm and said the worms need them.
Two children watered the vegetable garden without being asked.

title: The calm-down cushion
notes:
After a loud argument Eli went to the calm-down cushion.
He said "I feel cross" and took three breaths, then came back to the blocks.
He told me he is getting better at stopping before he hits.

title: The balance beam
notes:
Hana walked along the low balance beam with her arms out.
She then tried the higher beam and wobbled, but stayed on.
Later she showed a friend how to climb the ladder to the beam.

title: Soap and hats
notes:
Before morning tea Arun reminded Mei to wash her hands.
He said "soap keeps the germs away" and waited while she did it.
He also moved his hat onto his head before they went outside.

title: The hard puzzle
notes:
Kit did not leave the puzzle when the piece would not go in.
He turned the piece, frowned, and said "not that way" before he found the spot.
Then he pulled the harder puzzle off the shelf.

title: Vinegar and bicarb
notes:
Sienna poured vinegar onto the bicarb in the trough.
She guessed "it will bubble" and then tried it with warm water.
She asked why the second one bubbled faster.

title: The bridge, outside
notes:
Yesterday the children planned a bridge with the unit blocks.
Today they tried the same plan outside with cardboard and planks.
Leo said "we have to change it because the grass is not flat."

title: Tools for the insect hunt
notes:
The group gathered leaves, pegs and a cardboard tube for the insect hunt.
Amira said they needed the magnifying glass and went to get it.
They used what they found on the ground rather than asking for new toys.

title: Back and forth at the dough table
notes:
Luca and Aisha were at the dough table with a lump they called a nest.
She pointed at the dough and he poured a drip of water on it.
They went back and forth about the eggs until the nest looked wetter.

title: What does that say
notes:
The group listened to the picture book about the kookaburra.
Priya pointed at the word on the page and asked "what does that say?"
Two children joined in the rhyme on the last page.

title: The storm painting
notes:
Amira painted a storm with thick grey swirls.
She said the swirls are the wind and the yellow dot is her house.
She added blue dots for rain and looked at the painting for a while.

title: Big, small, big, small
notes:
Child A lined the stones up and said "big, small, big, small."
They counted the stones and said there were eight in the pattern.
Then they made the same pattern with the bottle tops.

title: Looking up the kookaburra
notes:
The children used the tablet to look up a picture of a kookaburra.
Jonah scrolled to a photo and said "that is the one from our book."
They drew the bird after looking at the screen.

title: After the bike fall
notes:
Mei fell off the bike and sat on the ground holding her knee.
Jonah knelt beside her and asked if it hurt.
He passed her the helmet and said they should put it on before they ride again.

title: The leaning tower
notes:
Sam and Nora kept adding blocks each time the tower leaned.
They talked about which block should go next and counted to twelve.
Nora said "let's keep trying" when it fell the first time.
